title: CROATIA LOST 7-0 TO ENGLAND. MODRIC STILL GAVE HARRY KANE A GIFT.
description:
Seven-nil down, and the captain still turned up with a present.

England beat Croatia 7-0, and Modric was the captain. He said losing wasn't the problem. The way they lost was. Seven goals is a lot of way. Spain won 2-1 in Split, with Merino scoring twice. Croatia scored once. Progress.

Through it all, Modric gave Harry Kane a replica of the first football brought to Croatia, which dates from 1880. Then, at 41, he played all ninety minutes as Milan beat Inter 3-1. Davor Suker says he'd do a great job in Real Madrid's administration. That's one man's opinion, not a club announcement.

Classy or cheeky? What would you call a gift after a 7-0?
